_about: 1-26, a route for the level that had none (wave 4a, round 1; build f20f0a4, WAKE). The door (428, 48) stands on platform_ent_1214,
behind door_lift_1043 (x 293 to 323, y 1 to 127): any ray from the ramps into the room above that platform crosses the door's span, so
no portal can be opened there until it is up. It rises 102.4 units while button_1044 (480, 230, on single_block_plat_ent_1075) is
pressed and falls when it is let go (step 133). The player cannot reach the button; a stone can. The launcher at (102, -42) sends a
stone down the shaft at x 102 every 156 ticks (it meets the ramp on ticks 191, 347 and 503), and each one rolls down the ramps and out
of the level. A portal over the button's block at (446, 180), shot from the start across the room (tap 40, in place on 164: the ray
passes 12 units under single_block_plat_ent_1041 and 27 over single_block_plat_ent_1076), and one in the shaft at (102, 100) (tap 230,
in place on 256, after stone 1 has gone by): stone 2 goes in on tick 332 and comes out of the first moving up, stops under the
platform, falls onto the right chamfer of single_block_plat_ent_1076 (345), rolls on to the block under the button and stops against the
wall at x 482 (asleep on 427). The button is pressed from tick 358, the door is up by 402, and the resting stone holds it there. A shot
through the doorway to (355, 76) (tap 392, in place on 492: the ray crosses the doorway at y 90, and the platform's corner (324, 96)
10 units under it) and one on the player (tap 500, through on 502): he comes out on the platform at (355, 78) and walks right into the
door (hold from 504, door on tick 529). The player never leaves the start block: the stones roll away from him (stone 3 meets the ramp
at x 110 on 503). 4 shots, none failed, medal 1 (8464 ms), no achievement (id 11 wants 8 stones alive at the door).
STANDS ON THE PORT'S OWN BODY PHYSICS, not measured on the original: the stone comes out of the portal moving up, is stopped 12 units under
platform_ent_1214 by the engine's contact brake (a Box2D stone would meet the platform with its speed), falls on the chamfer and rolls to the
wall at x 482 where it falls asleep on the button. So B's x window below (440 to 454) and the stone's end place are the port's; whether the
original's stone ends on the button the same way is a row for the final comparison.
WINDOWS (each measured with the others held): tap B 25 to 106 (the 400 ms from the level's start ends on tick 25; after 106 tap A meets
the first shot in flight); tap A 164 to 310 (before 164 it is in flight at B's landing, after 310 stone 2 has gone by before it lands);
B's aim x 440 to 454 at y 160 to 200 (x 436 and less lands the stone on the flat of block 1076, where it falls asleep on 373, the
button stays up and the shot at the doorway ends on the closed door; x 456 or more is off the view); tap C 370 to 400 (before 370 the door
still crosses the ray, after 400 tap D finds the shot in flight); C's aim x 325 to 375 at y 66 to 88 (y 92 at x 360 or more ends on the
platform's corner at (324, 101); x 385 is a flight too long for tap D at 500, and (400, 60) is the restart button's corner of the screen);
tap D from 491 on (the tick the shot is in place) and the walk from 498. Aim drift 0.001 px.
